decision: Reprimand (Driving) This is the driver's first reprimand for the 2025 season.
fact: Car 16 continued on track with significant and obvious damage
offence: Breach of Article 26.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Reprimand (Driving) This is the driver's first reprimand for the 2025 season.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 16 (Charles Leclerc), the team representative and reviewed video evidence. Car 16 hit the wall in Turn 10 and sustained significant damage. Nonetheless, the driver continued on track (at a low speed) and only stopped before Turn 14, after being told to do so by the team. The Stewards note that incidents during the Reconnaissance Laps will be regarded in the same way as incidents during Free Practice and therefore a reprimand is considered appropriate.
rules_referenced: Article 26.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 16 Driving A Car In An Unsafe Condition
